crop_policy_reconciliation.paper_metric_definition: AEE is averaged over active pixels where both GT and events are present; the paper does not specify a numeric rectangular crop.

crop_policy_reconciliation.candidate_recommendation: Use the full native 346x260 sensor raster for the primary sim-to-real comparison on all four sequences, with the common finite-nonzero-GT intersect common-event-active support. Record the exact legacy source ROI as a secondary compatibility diagnostic if research review requests it.
crop_policy_reconciliation.rationale: The candidates were trained and validated on shared native-resolution synthetic labels and use the native-resolution real adapter; a full sensor ROI avoids changing input geometry or introducing an outdoor-only crop into the primary comparison. This candidate does not claim exact reproduction of the historical paper/legacy implementation.

time_and_events.endpoint_definition: APS endpoint i to i+1; actual interval duration is timestamp[i+1]-timestamp[i] seconds
time_and_events.event_polarity_mapping: preserve +1 ON; map source OFF encoding 0 to -1 only as required by the pinned STE encoder
time_and_events.event_representation: pinned STE-style equal-event-count Gaussian-weighted ON/OFF tensor; 5 slices per APS interval
time_and_events.pairing: both models receive bit-identical event representation from the same MVSEC interval; evaluation support is common and shared

flow_gt.association: pinned estimate_corresponding_gt_flow semantics: each GT map is displacement to next GT timestamp; propagate/interpolate across APS endpoints using nearest-neighbor flow sampling
flow_gt.unit: px_per_interval (endpoint displacement in native sensor pixel coordinates)
flow_gt.invalid_gt: exclude any pixel where either component is non-finite or vector magnitude is zero
flow_gt.orientation: native DAVIS left raster, [u,v] == [x,y] displacement, arrays [2,260,346]

input_output_geometry.model_input: Stage 3 real adapter representation, centered zero-pad event tensor to 352x352; do not resize event coordinates or scale counts
input_output_geometry.model_output: require finite [1,2,352,352], crop the same recorded (y=46,x=3) pad offset back to [2,260,346]
input_output_geometry.metric_crop: apply official dataset-specific evaluation row crop after restoring the native raster; do not crop/resize GT independently

support_mask.rule: finite nonzero GT vector AND pixel active in the common real event representation AND within the sequence-specific evaluation crop
support_mask.event_active: any positive ON/OFF count in any of the five dt1 bins; EventGenesis and V2E artifacts must have bit-identical real event tensors, otherwise fail
support_mask.common_mask: one mask per sequence/window reused for both predictions
support_mask.empty_support: undefined window; preserve APS index and interval in common exclusion manifest, never convert to zero error or drop from registration

primary.name: AEE
primary.definition: mean sqrt((u_pred-u_gt)^2+(v_pred-v_gt)^2) over the common valid mask

secondary.outlier_definition: 100 * mean(EPE > 3 px AND EPE > 0.05 * GT_vector_magnitude) over the same common valid mask
secondary.legacy_reference_only: STE flow_error_dense reports fraction EPE < 3 px; report only as reference compatibility, not as the candidate Outlier metric
secondary.all_valid_gt_aee: optional diagnostic on finite nonzero GT without event-support intersection; cannot replace primary support

metrics.per_sequence: mean per-window AEE and Outlier over non-empty common-support windows; record count and excluded empty windows
metrics.dataset_aggregate: equal weight across the four registered sequences, irrespective of frame count
metrics.empty_sequence: fail closed; no four-sequence aggregate if any registered sequence has no scored support

scope_and_isolation.status: candidate only; research review must freeze protocol and authorize scoring before real metric artifacts are opened
